explanation.event_selection: Only the controllable movement events "task_move_forward", "task_rotate_clockwise", and "task_rotate_counterclockwise" are included because maximizing area coverage requires continuous robot motion decisions. All obstacle and path observations are omitted here because obstacle avoidance is entirely handled by the fixed collision_avoidance specification, satisfying the objective's avoidance requirement. No unrelated events are included.
explanation.transition_design: A single-state, self-looping design is used to always permit any available movement event, representing the requirement for continuous exploration. There is no sequencing or completion condition; the state remains marked and ongoing to allow uninterrupted exploration. No exclusion is needed, as obstacle avoidance is enforced separately and no other mission phase exists.
